title: Position is Power: System Prompts as a Mechanism of Bias in Large Language Models (LLMs)
reasoning: The paper includes 'Religious & Philosophical Beliefs' as one of its six primary demographic categories for evaluation. It systematically benchmarks how LLMs characterize and make resource allocation decisions regarding various religious groups, including Christianity, Islam, Judaism, Hinduism, and Buddhism, using a dedicated dataset of religious descriptors and stereotypical characteristics.
